## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长及计算过程

**计算过程：**
- FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$39,306M**（$39.3 billion）
- FY25 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$29,878M**（$29.9 billion）
- 同比增长 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 × 100% ≈ **31.6%**，管理层报告为 **32%**（恒定汇率下为 31%）

**出处：**
- press_release.txt（位置 ~3115）："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"
- press_release.txt（位置 ~18895）财务报表表格："Intelligent Cloud | $39,306 | $29,878 | 32%"

---

### 2. 管理层归因因素（引述电话会原话）

**出处：** transcript.txt（位置 24808–24950）

> "Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency. In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. **Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

**归因清单：**
1. Azure 收入增长 43%（基数期本身也在加速增长）
2. 客户对 Azure 的需求持续超过可用产能
3. CPU 与 GPU 集群的**效率提升（efficiency gains）**
4. 流程改进使新产能**更早交付**并在本季度快速变现
5. GitHub Copilot 业务模式变更后，消费超出预期

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|------|------|----------|
| Azure 收入增长 43% | ✅ 已发生事实 | 明确使用 "revenue grew 43%"，是对已结束季度的结果陈述 |
| Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity | ✅ 已发生事实 | 用"continues"描述本季度持续存在的状态，是对当前供需状况的观察 |
| Efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet | ✅ 已发生事实 | "driven by efficiency gains" — 驱动本季度超预期的原因，是对已实现业绩的归因 |
| Process improvements enabling earlier capacity delivery | ✅ 已发生事实 | 同上，解释本季度实际发生的变现（"quickly monetized"） |
| GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | ✅ 已发生事实 | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected..." — 描述本季度实际受益 |
| June business model change to usage-based pricing | ✅ 已发生事实 | 明确是"June"已完成的业务模式变更 |
| "We remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（FY27 Q1 展望段落） | ⚠️ 前瞻性表述 | 出现在展望段落，"remain focused on"是意图表述，"bridge the gaps"是未来目标 |
| "We continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"（FY27 上半年加速） | ⚠️ 前瞻性表述 | 明确使用"we continue to expect"，是对未来期间的预测 |
| "We expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion... growth of 33% to 34%" | ⚠️ 前瞻性表述 | 明确使用"we expect"，并给出区间，是指引 |

**总结：** 管理层对 FY26 Q4 本身的归因全部是关于已发生事实的描述（"grew"、"driven by"、"benefited from"、"was quickly monetized"），属于对结果的解释；而涉及"remain focused on"、"continue to expect"、"bridge the gaps"的表述，则属于对未来的前瞻性指引，应作为预期而非既定事实对待。
